answer: Give every operator a leniency window: each epoch a key files a sealed kin list naming the other keys its operator runs. Declared kin still earn, but as one beam split by a prism: 1.0 for the first key, 0.2 for each extra. A key later tied by funding-graph or timing audits to an undeclared sibling forfeits all locked vesting rewards of the whole cluster. If each audit tide catches 30% of hidden links, 10 hidden aliases walk a ridge with ~97% odds of losing everything within 10 epochs, while declaring costs 0.8 seat each. Audit recall is checked with planted test farms.
